notes: The one list of what each stack's deploy command applies. A commit that touches an input stays undeployed until John runs that command, which stamps the stack's InfraDeployCommit tag with the landed main commit it applied. plan:infra and check:infra-drift import this file; .gitattributes marks the same paths infra-input for the shared pre-commit reminder, and scripts/check-infra-drift.test.mjs pins the two lists together.
